name: SGGX Parameter Fitting from Directional Transparencies
aliases: Computing temporary parameters ρ0 and A0
Computing temporary parameters ρ0 and A0 from directional transparencies
definition: Computes initial microflake parameters (density ρ0 and self-shadowing A0) for a low-resolution voxel to match the directional transparencies of the input high-resolution voxel block.
summary: SGGX Parameter Fitting from Directional Transparencies computes initial microflake density and self-shadowing to match input voxel transparencies, distinguishing itself via isotropic or exact anisotropic variants.
